readmeExcerpt: This is a Mathematica package containing commands for implementing functionalities commonly needed in quantum information processing. These are useful for doing theoretical computations on quantum information protocols. For instance, one could easily use it to work through the teleportation protocol with a perfect Bell state, and then to see what happens to the fidelity of the output state when a noisy Bell state is shared instead. The ability to choose random states etc. can be useful for finding counterexamples to particular statements, or for gaining confidence in a statement prior to proving it.
